title_alternatives: She Couldn’t Fix the Cup—So She Gave It a New Purpose

metadata_draft.description: A cracked cup seems useless until one small seed gives it a new purpose. In this silent 2D stick-figure story, one figure turns a leaking cup into a planter, then inspires a shared garden. Told through action with an original instrumental score and no voiceover.
growth_hypotheses: The leaking cup in the opening five seconds may make the conflict legible without dialogue; validate with retention at 0:05.
The cup-to-flower transformation may improve completion or rewatch; validate with average percentage viewed and retention dips.
The shared garden payoff may increase shares; validate with shares per view and qualitative comments.
